pocketOrder: pocket n is the integer whose bit k is qubit k, so counts[n] and wheel[n] are pocket n
opening: before any card the house spins the wheel fair: H on every qubit
houseRule: the house only plays a card that holds the player to the most they can still force; where several do, the game picks one of the listed houseCards uniformly
bet: after the draft the player sees the wheel and puts one straight-up chip on any pocket; the spin lands on one pocket
stakeRule: the stake is fixed before the house plays its first card and can't change during the draft; the game enforces this
spin: each spin samples one shot from runs[].points[].counts for the finished draft; the game plays the ibm-chip run when one covers every finished draft and has an edge entry, otherwise the run named in playRun

fairWheel.method: Qiskit statevector of the opening spin, before any card

classicalWheel.method: Qiskit DensityMatrix with every qubit measured after the opening and after each card, so no superposition carries between cards; best pocket over every legal draft

houseLimit.method: minimax over every legal draft, each wheel a Qiskit statevector: the house plays to keep the best pocket unlikely, the player to make it likely

playStyles.rule: the best line against the house's play
always plays the card that makes the best pocket likeliest right now
plays any card left, at random

payouts.rule: fair total return at the house limit times 0.95, with net profit on a 100 stake rounded down to a multiple of 5
payouts.basis: fairPays, breakEven and houseEdge use the exact wheel's house limit; edge[] has each run's own returns

clear.rule: win a straight-up bet on a pocket at the house limit, one of the spin's limitPockets: it needs the best line, then a lucky spin
clear.basis: chance is the exact wheel's house limit; edge[].clearChance is each run's own figure

wheelsMethod: Qiskit Statevector probabilities of the draft so far, rounded to 12 decimal places

noiseModel.name: fake_kingston
noiseModel.qubitSelection: best-case pick: each tied pair on a coupler, choosing the five qubits and two couplers with the lowest readout, sx and CZ error in the snapshot, weighted by the clearing line's use; qubits is a layout, so logical qubit k sits on entry k
noiseModel.scope: gate and readout errors on the chosen qubits only, as fake_kingston's full model has them; left out: decay while a qubit waits idle for the others, crosstalk, and leakage

edge.method: bestReturn: the most any player strategy gets back per chip against the house's play, picking the pocket with the most shots in this run. worstSpin: the finished draft whose best pocket returns most per chip, which bounds a player who could change the stake after seeing the draft. clearChance: the best chance per spin of clearing, with the pocket one of the limitPockets, averaged over them
